en: Compare the corner building, shopfronts and the two streets meeting here.
zh: 比较转角建筑、沿街店面和两条道路交会的方式。

en: Notice the narrow lanes and the close spacing of the homes.
Consider how an ordinary home could also be a place of writing and debate.
zh: 观察狭窄弄堂与紧密相邻的住宅。
想一想，普通住宅如何也成为写作与思想交流的空间。

en: Compare the heavy architectural forms with the openness of the riverfront.
If you enter, notice how the gallery spaces shape your encounter with the artworks.
zh: 比较建筑厚重的形体与滨江开阔空间。
如进入展厅，留意空间如何影响观看作品的方式。

en: Look at the stone-framed entrances and the lanes between the houses.
Compare the residential scale of the buildings with their present commercial uses.
zh: 观察石框门以及房屋之间的弄堂。
比较建筑原有的住宅尺度与今天的商业用途。

en: Compare the different facades and the spaces between them.
Look for the relationship between restored buildings and their new uses.
zh: 比较不同立面的形式与建筑之间的空间。
留意修缮后的建筑与新用途之间的关系。

en: Look at the lane widths and the transitions between older buildings and their present uses.
zh: 观察弄堂宽度，以及老建筑与当下用途之间的衔接。

en: Notice the doorways and repeating house fronts from the public parts of the lanes.
zh: 在公共通道上留意门洞与连续住宅立面的节奏。

en: Look at the relationship between the lane entrance and the homes beyond; keep residential access clear.
zh: 观察弄口与内部住宅的关系，保持居民通道畅通。

en: Notice how the building's narrow corner changes as you walk past it.
zh: 边走边观察建筑狭窄转角带来的不同视觉效果。

en: Look from the historic Bund buildings across the river to Pudong.
Read the river and the two skylines together as different chapters of the city.
zh: 从外滩历史建筑望向江对岸的浦东。
把黄浦江和两岸天际线一起看作城市的不同时代。

en: Watch how a doorway or window frames the next view.
If you enter, compare the enclosed garden with the busy streets outside.
zh: 观察门洞或窗景如何框出下一幅画面。
如入园，比较园内空间与外侧街巷的不同节奏。

en: Notice how memorial spaces and everyday park activities sit alongside one another.
Observe public life from a respectful distance without interrupting it.
zh: 留意纪念空间与日常公园活动如何相邻共存。
保持适当距离观察公共生活，不打扰活动中的人。

en: Look at the relationship between the temple and the surrounding shopping streets.
Notice religious and commercial details while respecting worshippers.
zh: 观察庙宇与周围商业街巷的空间关系。
留意信仰与商业元素，也尊重现场祭拜活动。

en: Notice the relationship between the villa, garden and domestic scale.
If open for visiting, connect personal rooms and objects with the public history described on site.
zh: 留意住宅、花园与生活空间的尺度关系。
如开放参观，将生活空间与现场介绍的公共历史联系起来。

en: Compare the scale of the houses, gardens and paths between them.
zh: 比较住宅、花园与其间道路的尺度。

en: Compare the intimate scale of the historic meeting site with the larger memorial spaces.
Use the on-site displays to place the 1921 meeting in the city around it.
zh: 比较历史会址的亲近尺度与纪念空间。
结合现场陈列，把1921年的会议放回当时的上海语境。

en: If open, look at how books and displays connect writers with the neighborhood outside.
zh: 如开放，留意书籍与陈列如何把作家与外面的街区联系起来。

en: Read the on-site account of the writers' group and compare it with the modest scale of the building.
zh: 阅读现场对作家团体的介绍，再观察建筑的日常尺度。

en: Follow the relationship between ramps, bridges and columns.
Consider how circulation designed for industrial work is experienced by visitors today.
zh: 观察坡道、桥廊与立柱如何组织空间。
想一想，原为工业流程设计的动线如何变成今天的游览体验。

en: Compare the museum building with the surrounding riverfront spaces.
If you visit an exhibition, notice how the gallery and outdoor setting affect the experience.
zh: 比较美术馆建筑与周边滨江空间。
如参观展览，留意展厅与室外环境带来的不同感受。

en: Look at the scale and curved surfaces of the former tanks.
Notice how the tanks relate to open public space around them.
zh: 观察油罐巨大的尺度与弧形表面。
留意罐体与周围开放公共空间的关系。

en: Notice where people choose to sit, meet and pause.
Compare the connections between indoor uses and the riverfront public space.
zh: 留意人们选择在哪里坐下、相聚和停留。
比较室内用途与滨江公共空间如何连接。

en: Choose one work and consider the city or society that might have made it possible.
Read the exhibition context before drawing conclusions about an artwork.
zh: 选一件作品，思考怎样的城市或社会生活让它成为可能。
先读展览说明，再形成自己对作品的理解。

en: Notice the Gothic forms against the surrounding Shanghai streetscape.
Respect worship and follow on-site access guidance when entering.
zh: 观察哥特式建筑形式与周围上海街景的对照。
入内时遵守现场指引，尊重宗教活动。

en: Notice how reading spaces relate to the surrounding Xujiahui streets; follow access guidance.
zh: 留意阅读空间与徐家汇街区的关系，并遵守入内指引。

en: Compare long-established storefronts with newer retail displays.
Look above the signs to notice the buildings behind the shopping street.
zh: 比较老字号门面与新式商业展示。
把视线移到招牌上方，观察商业街背后的建筑。

en: Compare the pedestrian routes, shop entrances and changing scale of the surrounding buildings.
zh: 比较行人通道、商场入口与周边建筑的不同尺度。

en: Look at the scale and structure of the art-center building from the public approach.
zh: 从公共通道观察艺术中心建筑的尺度与结构。

en: Notice the curved roofline and its relationship with the open plaza.
zh: 留意弧形屋顶轮廓与开阔广场的关系。

en: Watch how skaters use ramps and edges while keeping well clear of their movement paths.
zh: 观察滑板运动如何使用坡面与边缘，并远离运动轨迹。

en: Look along the park's long axis and notice how paths organize movement through it.
zh: 沿公园长轴望去，观察道路如何组织穿行。

en: Compare the tower's vertical form with the open river and plaza around it.
zh: 比较塔的竖向形态与周围开阔的江面、广场。

en: Look at the crane's frame and imagine the movement its industrial function required.
zh: 观察塔吊框架，想象其工业用途所需要的运动方式。

en: Compare the theatre's exterior with the riverfront public space around it.
zh: 比较剧院外部形态与周围滨江公共空间。

en: Look for traces of time, skill and material choices in the objects on display.
Compare the crafts with the architectural setting around them.
zh: 观察展品中体现的制作时间、技艺与材料选择。
比较工艺展品与周围建筑环境。

en: Notice the transition from the old-city streets into the park's planted spaces.
zh: 留意从老城街巷进入公园绿地时的空间变化。

en: Compare the park paths with the rhythm of the surrounding neighborhood streets.
zh: 比较公园步道与周边街区道路的不同节奏。

en: Look at old buildings, side lanes and changes in the streetscape.
Use plaques or displays to connect literary names with actual places.
zh: 观察老建筑、支弄与街景的变化。
借助铭牌或展陈，把文学人物与具体地点联系起来。

en: Look at street-level details and the rhythm of the residential facades as you walk.
zh: 步行时留意街道细节与住宅立面的连续节奏。

en: Notice how paths and waterside spaces connect to the streets around the park.
zh: 观察步道、水边空间如何连接周围街道。

en: Watch how the park offers places to pause within a busy urban neighborhood.
zh: 留意公园如何在繁忙街区中提供停留空间。

en: Compare the paths and planted spaces with how visitors use them.
Pause to observe everyday activities without interrupting participants.
zh: 比较园路与绿化的布局，以及人们实际使用它们的方式。
停下来观察日常活动，不打扰参与者。

en: Look beyond a single landmark to the trees, pavements and adjoining buildings.
Notice the overlap of residential life, small businesses and visitors.
zh: 把视线从单个地标扩展到树木、人行道和相邻建筑。
观察居住生活、小商业与游客活动如何交织。

en: Look at how planted areas and paths separate a quiet pause from the street outside.
zh: 观察绿化与步道如何将安静的停留空间与外侧道路区分开。

en: Notice the change in sound and pace as you move from the pavement into the park.
zh: 从人行道走入公园时，留意声音与步行节奏的变化。

en: Observe the lane entrance and residential scale from public space without entering private areas.
zh: 从公共空间观察弄口与住宅尺度，不进入私人区域。

en: Look at how paths connect the square to surrounding institutions and streets.
Notice the different reasons people pass through or pause here.
zh: 观察步道如何连接广场、周边机构与街道。
留意人们经过这里或在此停留的不同方式。

en: Look for book-related storefronts and compare them with the surrounding commercial street.
zh: 留意与书籍有关的门面，并与周边商业街景作比较。

en: If open, connect the rooms and displays with the history described on site.
zh: 如开放参观，将房间与陈列联系到现场介绍的历史。

en: Look at the apartment facade from the pavement and respect the privacy of residents.
zh: 从人行道观察公寓立面，尊重居民隐私。

en: Observe how the neighborhood entrance connects the main street with smaller residential lanes.
zh: 观察街区入口如何将主路与较小的居住弄堂连接起来。

en: If open, notice how drawings and domestic objects help tell the artist's story.
zh: 如开放，留意画作与生活物件如何讲述艺术家的故事。

en: Notice how the concert hall meets the street and how its entrance guides visitors.
zh: 观察音乐厅与街道的衔接，以及入口如何引导访客。

en: Compare the park's paths and open spaces with the surrounding city buildings.
zh: 比较公园步道、开放空间与周边城市建筑。

en: Use the on-site interpretation to connect the home's everyday spaces with the life commemorated here.
zh: 借助现场说明，将住宅的日常空间与纪念人物的经历联系起来。

en: If open, look for the relationship between writing, displayed works and the scale of the home.
zh: 如开放，留意书写、陈列作品与住宅尺度之间的关系。

en: Observe the exterior from public space and read any on-site heritage information for historical context.
zh: 从公共空间观察建筑外部，并借助现场历史说明理解其背景。

en: If an exhibition is open, compare its contemporary themes with the older streetscape outside.
zh: 如有开放展览，比较当代主题与外部较老街景的关系。
